{{Top|leg}}
The '''Makeb Tourism Initiative''' was a company dealing in tourism to [[Makeb]], a planet in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. After the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the company adopted the slogan "Makeb. We Haven't Blown Up Yet." and used it while co-sponsoring [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] matches on [[Vandin]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=warzone|Sky Shredder}}</ref>
